candidates.title: Why the Tsavo Lions Kept Killing Rail Workers for 9 Months
candidates.concept: Brief hero (opening image): night, a lantern-lit canvas tent seen from outside, two big lean maneless lion heads pushing through the flap with lit blank eyes; tiny Doug in a camp bed inside, blanket to his chin, looking at the camera

candidates.title: How Two Lions Killed Enough Men to Stop a Railway in 1898
candidates.concept: Doug alone in an empty railway camp holding a shovel, waving at a packed departing steam train, two pairs of lit lion eyes in the dry grass behind him

candidates.title: How Doug Would Die Guarding the Tsavo Railway Camp in 1898
candidates.concept: Doug hugging the top of a thin tree at night, the second lean maneless lion sitting below looking up, patient, eyes lit

candidates.title: Why the Tsavo Lions Killed People When They Weren't Starving
candidates.concept: A clean, simple lion skull with one broken lower canine circled in red; Doug in a white coat holding a tiny dental mirror up to it

candidates.title: The Tsavo Lions Had the Creepiest Hair Stuck in Their Teeth
candidates.concept: The two maneless lions mounted in a museum glass case, one mouth open with a red circle on a broken tooth; Doug's red cap on the floor of the case

candidates.title: Why Two Tsavo Lions Could Kill Through Thorn Fences and Fire
candidates.concept: A camp ringed by a spiky thorn fence with fires inside; a gap pushed open from outside, a lean maneless lion stepping through; Doug stuck in the fence with an ankle bandage

candidates.title: Why the Tsavo Lions Got Deadlier the Longer the Railway Ran
candidates.concept: A dusty railway line at dusk, the safety board DAYS WITHOUT AN INCIDENT wiped to 0 by a paw; Doug alone holding a shovel, two maneless silhouettes on the embankment

candidates.title: Why the Tsavo Lions Walked Into a Crowded Camp to Kill
candidates.concept: A lean maneless lion strolling between campfires and tents at night, blank lit eyes; Doug on night watch with a lantern, holding a sketch of a fluffy-maned lion

candidates.title: The Scariest Part of the Tsavo Man-Eaters Was in Their Hair
candidates.concept: Split frame: a thick old book labelled 1907 on the left, a lab test tube with a single lion hair on the right; Doug between them with a calculator

candidates.title: Why a Tsavo Lion Hunted the Man Trying to Kill It
candidates.concept: A rickety platform on four thin poles at night, two glowing eyes circling its base on a dotted path; Doug and a plain stick figure in a hat holding very still on top
